examples.title: Accessible Form Field
examples.description: Form field with proper label association and ARIA attributes
examples.code:
<Stack direction="vertical" gap="xs">
  <Label htmlFor="email-input">Email Address</Label>
  <Textfield 
    id="email-input"
    data-size="medium"
    placeholder="Enter email"
    aria-describedby="email-help"
    aria-required="true"
  />
  <Text variant="caption" size="xs" id="email-help" style={{ color: 'var(--ds-color-neutral-text-subtle)' }}>
    We'll never share your email
  </Text>
</Stack>

examples.title: Accessible Icon Button
examples.description: Icon button with descriptive aria-label for screen readers
examples.code:
<Button 
  data-color="accent" 
  data-size="medium"
  aria-label="Save changes"
  onClick={handleSave}
>
  <SaveIcon style={{ width: 16, height: 16 }} aria-hidden="true" />
</Button>

examples.title: Accessible Error Message
examples.description: Form field with error message properly associated via aria-describedby
examples.code:
<Stack direction="vertical" gap="xs">
  <Label htmlFor="password-input">Password</Label>
  <Textfield 
    id="password-input"
    type="password"
    data-size="medium"
    error="Password must be at least 8 characters"
    aria-invalid="true"
    aria-describedby="password-error"
  />
  <Text 
    id="password-error"
    variant="caption" 
    size="xs" 
    style={{ color: 'var(--ds-color-danger-text-default)' }}
    role="alert"
  >
    Password must be at least 8 characters
  </Text>
</Stack>

examples.title: Skip to Main Content Link
examples.description: Skip link for keyboard users to bypass navigation
examples.code:
<Link 
  href="#main-content"
  style={{ 
    position: 'absolute',
    left: '-9999px',
    zIndex: 9999
  }}
  onFocus={(e) => e.target.style.left = '0'}
  onBlur={(e) => e.target.style.left = '-9999px'}
>
  Skip to main content
</Link>
<main id="main-content" tabIndex={-1}>
  {/* Main content */}
</main>

examples.title: Accessible Modal Dialog
examples.description: Modal with proper ARIA attributes, focus management, and keyboard support
examples.code:
<Dialog 
  open={isOpen} 
  onClose={handleClose}
  aria-labelledby="modal-title"
  aria-describedby="modal-description"
>
  <Dialog.Header>
    <Heading level={2} id="modal-title" data-size="medium">
      Confirm Action
    </Heading>
  </Dialog.Header>
  <Dialog.Content>
    <Paragraph id="modal-description">
      Are you sure you want to proceed?
    </Paragraph>
  </Dialog.Content>
  <Dialog.Footer>
    <Stack direction="horizontal" justify="end" gap="sm">
      <Button data-variant="tertiary" onClick={handleClose}>
        Cancel
      </Button>
      <Button data-color="accent" onClick={handleConfirm}>
        Confirm
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  </Dialog.Footer>
</Dialog>
